# Facebook Group, Page & Profile Posts Scraper with Comments

Apify Actor: https://apify.com/spbotdel/facebook-group-posts-comments-scraper
Actor ID: D4fo5uWHFVEb4FYJ2
GitHub: https://github.com/spbotdel/facebook-group-posts-comments-scraper
MCP endpoint: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=spbotdel/facebook-group-posts-comments-scraper

## What this tool does

Collects public Facebook group, page, and personal-profile posts with their public comments and replies in one run, without cookies or login. Rows can be posts with nested comments, or separate post and comment rows.

## Choose this Actor for

- group, page, or profile posts with comments in one run;
- scheduled comment monitoring with deduplication;
- AI-ready post/comment datasets;
- CSV/JSON export for social listening and community research;
- MCP, n8n, API, or webhook workflows.

## Do not choose this Actor for

- private, friends-only, or login-required content;
- Reels or photo pages that Facebook does not serve logged out;
- global Facebook keyword search;
- bypassing Facebook access restrictions.

## Minimal input

```json
{
  "startUrls": [{ "url": "https://www.facebook.com/groups/<id>/" }],
  "maxPostsPerGroup": 3,
  "commentsMode": "full",
  "maxCommentsPerPost": 20,
  "includeReplies": true
}
```

For a page or profile, pass `userData.surfaceType` as `page` or `profile` when the URL is ambiguous.

## MCP usage

Minimal `call-actor` input:

```json
{ "startUrls": [{ "url": "https://www.facebook.com/groups/<id>/" }], "maxPostsPerGroup": 3, "commentsMode": "full", "maxCommentsPerPost": 20 }
```

Recommended `callOptions`:

```json
{ "memory": 1024, "timeoutSecs": 600, "maxTotalChargeUsd": 0.10 }
```

After the run, read dataset items with `get-dataset-items` and the `SUMMARY` record with `get-key-value-store-record`.

## Result grain and pricing

One result equals one post, and optionally one result per comment when `commentsOutput` is `separate`. Posts are scanned and billed even when no new comments are found. Paid plans: from $3 per 1,000 posts plus $1 per 1,000 comments, plus a $0.005 run start. FREE tier: $6 per 1,000 posts plus $2 per 1,000 comments.

## Limits

- Public content only; hidden or restricted comments are not returned.
- Logged-out group feeds can stop before the announced total; read `coverage_status` and `SUMMARY`.
- Comment availability depends on Facebook's public surface.
